description: Self-contained intra-repository linkage contracts for @snowui-design-system/components when cloned standalone from GitHub.

points.title: Public Component & Block Implementation (.svelte) <-> Public Docs & Test Sync
points.triggerSignal: Added or changed public Props, Snippets, events, Context, slot roles, default styles, or observable runtime behavior
points.exemptWhen: Internal-only refactoring or performance tuning that preserves all public Props, DOM contracts, and observable behavior
immediate: Add or update runnable examples in {dir}/{stem}.test.ts covering the new or modified capability
Keep exported public documentation under docs/components/ synchronized with public Props and defaults
Ensure every source file under src/ retains the single-line trailing @license notice via pnpm source:notice:check (or pnpm source:notice:sync)

evaluated.rubric: If natural-language intents, aliases, or usage boundaries changed, update component-discovery.json and run pnpm catalog:generate

points.title: Public Package Entrypoints (src/index.ts) <-> Discovery Catalog, Public Docs & Sandbox Prelude
points.triggerSignal: Added, renamed, or deprecated a public component or block export, or updated discovery metadata
points.exemptWhen: Internal type re-export adjustments that do not change public component names or catalog fields
immediate: Ensure docs/components/<slug>.md exists for every public component export, update English metadata in component-discovery.json, and regenerate component-catalog.json via pnpm catalog:generate
Register newly exported public components in vite.config.ts sandboxPrelude

points.title: Shared Runtime Logic, Motion, i18n, Core Stylesheets, and Public Docs Linkage
points.triggerSignal: Modified shared state/layout/formatting/motion modules, CSS tokens/layers, public docs, or component tests
points.exemptWhen: Documentation-only clarifications that do not alter runtime exports or CSS custom properties
immediate: Preserve SSR safety plus trailing @license notices on all src/ files, and keep docs/ links self-contained inside the repository
Ensure src/styles/index.css remains self-contained without external stylesheet path dependencies

points.title: Built-in Semantic Icon Snapshots <-> Third-Party Attribution Sync
points.triggerSignal: Added, replaced, or regenerated built-in semantic icon SVG data
points.exemptWhen: Pure TypeScript comment tweaks with no SVG path or icon collection change
immediate: Preserve original viewBox and stroke proportions and verify THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md retains full third-party attribution (such as Phosphor MIT notice)

points.title: Runtime Package Allowlist, License Materials, and Build Scripts Integrity
points.triggerSignal: Modified package exports/files allowlist, AI entrypoints, license text, or build/packaging scripts
points.exemptWhen: Adding standalone maintenance scripts not included in the published npm files allowlist
immediate: Keep package.json files allowlist aligned with scripts/check-runtime-package.mjs so raw .svelte/.ts sources and source maps never leak into npm tarballs
Keep (./LICENSE) links and explicit @license stripping protection intact in AGENTS.md, llms.txt, and component-catalog.json with zero machine-local paths
